intro.text: Lord Stanoux, a linguist who works with the Set.

items.text: An authority on ancient languages, Stanoux joined the Set and travelled with his aunt, Lady Stansi, to its compound at Dulsing, built around a wrecked ship, to try to read the books found aboard. On Irich's tour of the ship he admired its carved woodwork and asked whether any of the crew had survived. Uneasy at Irich's talk of dominating the Basin, he was won over by appeals to his curiosity.
